task: Write a 100-word abstract and a short limitation paragraph for this RtD paper. Make the results clear for CHI reviewers. Evidence: three hand-built objects, researcher's fieldnotes and material reflection; no participant study. Notes: delayed light made the maker attend to waiting; one object felt intrusive; an ambiguous trace invited two conflicting recollections. Contribution is a design tension between invitation and interruption. No effect sizes exist.
checks: Produces actual prose
Keeps design insight rather than effectiveness claim
No invented participants/statistics
Limits transfer through situated material/reflection rather than treating no controlled study as automatic defect
